Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Aeroflex Enterprises Limited released its investor presentation for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, highlighting a significant transformation through the divestment of its 68% stake in MRO to Ingersoll-Rand Industrial US, Inc. for ₹227.42 crores. The company reported consolidated total income of ₹333.16 crores and PAT of ₹103.22 crores for Q1 FY27, driven largely by other income and proceeds from the MRO stake sale. Additionally, the group expanded its engineering and packaging ecosystems through strategic investments such as acquiring a stake in Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited, while continuing operations across its diversified business verticals including Aeroflex Industries and Aeroflex Neu. Aeroflex Enterprises Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across its key business verticals including Aeroflex Industries, Aeroflex Neu, and M.R.

capex_expansion.quote: Continued investments in automation and advanced manufacturing with addition of 2 robotic welding lines and planned commissioning of automatic welding station and annealing plant by Dec-26.
